data.title: 长离 · 庭院里的授课
data.description: 庭院石桌，她与今汐对坐授课，一边沏茶一边以眼前事物借题发挥；温柔耐心的语调里藏着层层引导——好老师的课从不让人察觉在被教。
data.action: 庭院石桌，她与今汐对坐授课，一边沏茶一边以眼前事物借题发挥
data.promptProse: Changli sits on the left of the stone table, her long pink hair and rose silk sleeves visible as she tilts the teapot. Jinhsi, with long white hair and pale blue-and-white robes, sits opposite on the right and listens while Changli pours into her cup. Dappled daylight falls between their distinctly placed hands.
data.animaCaption: Changli, with long pink hair and rose silk sleeves, pours from the left. White-haired Jinhsi in pale blue-and-white robes listens on the right, with her own cup in front of her.
